description: This file defines a set of REST API endpoints for managing products in an inventory system, including creating, listing (with pagination), retrieving by ID, updating, and deleting products using FastAPI. It uses SQLAlchemy ORM models for database interactions and schemas for request/response validation.

methods.name: create_product(product: schemas.ProductCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Create a new product with initial stock after checking for duplicate SKU.

methods.name: list_products(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve all products, ordered by most recent.

methods.name: list_products_paged( offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Starting offset"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100, description="Max results"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieve products with pagination support via offset and limit.

methods.name: get_product(product_id: int = Path(..., gt=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific product by ID.

methods.name: update_product(product_id: int, payload: schemas.ProductUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Update fields of a specific product, with checks for SKU duplication.

ctags.signature: (product_id: int = Path(..., gt=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
